symptom: Full project package refused a changing SQLite export; transaction context did not close/checkpoint its WAL before hashing.
root_cause: sqlite3 connection context commits/rolls back transactions but leaves the connection open. WAL changes and authentication redaction were not guaranteed in the standalone main database until final close.
detection: Real full-project packaging failed its source digest stability check; live-WAL reproduction and deterministic retained-connection regression failed on old code.
fix: Explicitly close both SQLite backup connections before hashing/packing the copy; WAL checkpoint completes before credential redaction is relied on.
prevention_rule: WAL-mode snapshots must close both handles, contain no copied auth bytes/rows, retain business rows and pass integrity_check as a main-file-only copy.
